title: Evaluate Python 3.13's optional free-threaded build
summary: Python 3.13 provides an experimental optional free-threaded build. CPU-bound threaded workloads may benefit, but compatibility and performance must be measured locally before adopting it.
conditions: Requires an optional free-threaded CPython build.
Assess third-party extension compatibility and target platform support.
limitations: Experimental in Python 3.13; no performance gain has been measured by Duck Tape.
The runtime version is not a PyPI dependency. Private repository runtime matching belongs to B.
